decisions: No current target-owned sets in canonical quiz manifest or By production targets; retain unrelated legacy and archival data.
Use 21 reviewed location-specific candidates and ten selected QuizCard questions; do not overwrite Place data.
existing_quiz_audit.knowledge_migration: New target-owned quiz; canonical generator assigns Knowledge links; no fabricated IDs.

profile_decision.justification: Kildene bærer tre distinkte sett: tidligere forsvars-/hageområde og kommunal omforming; navne- og trafikklag; kildegrenser, offentlig rom og Stortingets tunnel. 21 spørsmål uten rene årstallsfasiter.

held_back_candidates: Question stems whose correct answer is merely a year, and trivia about neighboring buildings unrelated to the independent Place.
Unsourced exact placements of destroyed Bukkebjerget, old stops or tunnels beyond named source assertions.
